productOwnerAuthorization.statement: roll back would have been nice but we have evidence that our 160 work is solid so let's proceed

acceptedRisk.fact: No preserved beta.159 deployment and volume was available to prove rollback isolation.
acceptedRisk.consequence: Production recovery cannot rely on a demonstrated beta.159 rollback environment.

freshState: Provision a uniquely named beta.160 NATS volume.
Prove zero streams, consumers, messages, and bytes before the first production write.
Abort on retained state, ambiguous volume identity, or any beta.159 mount.
crossVersion: Never attach beta.159 state to beta.160.
Never attach beta.160 state to beta.159.
Isolate any later-discovered beta.159 volume for separate owner-reviewed handling.
evidenceAndBackup: Preserve the complete persistence-r5 archive and recorded hashes without overwrite.
Before writes, verify recoverable backups of authoritative reseed inputs and rendered configuration.
Back up deployment metadata and all nondisposable product data.
Restore only into newly provisioned beta.160 storage.
monitoring: Poll authoritative health, target and indexed revisions, and critical CS API probes every 30-60 seconds.
Poll JetStream observation and schema artifact reads at the same cadence.
Continue heightened monitoring through cutover and at least 60 minutes after traffic begins.
Treat logs as supplementary evidence; silence is not success.
abort: Stop new writes and remove traffic on failed preflight, wrong version or image, or failed canonical probes.
Abort on storage error, revision regression, or no progress for more than twice the expected step duration.
Preserve incident evidence and use forward repair or a clean beta.160 rebuild.

nonClaims: No beta.159 volume is approved for beta.160 use.
No technical or conformance gate is weakened by this acceptance.
